Updates an existing media plan (plan fields only; cards are managed via dedicated card endpoints).
Query Median plan by Id, Median plan info and all Cards

Deletes a media plan and all its cards.
Only the creator of the plan can delete it.

Copies a media plan and all its cards.
The new plan's name is prefixed with "Copy of ".
Returns the new plan's Id.
Adds a new card to an existing media plan.

Deletes the specified cards under the given plan.
Returns the number of deleted rows.

Updates cards with TargetType-based splitting. Parses TargetRequest, groups targets
by type (AudienceContext / Category / ProductKeyword / Deal), and upserts/deletes
cards per group within a single transaction.
Front-end sends: {[{ "cardId": 517, "data": { "SupplyPackage": ..., "TargetRequest": ... } }]}

Updates a single card's editable fields (SupplyPackage / Target / Budget / IsLock / SortOrder).
Automatically clears ReachDataPoints, PerformanceDataPoints, ReachApiStatus, PerformanceApiStatus.

Batch-updates multiple cards. Each item must include the card Id.
Returns the number of cards successfully updated.

Batch-updates the Budget and IsLock fields for multiple cards.
Other fields remain unchanged.

Same as {updateWithSplit} but operates across multiple plans in a single call.
Each entry specifies a {planId} and its list of cards to update.
Returns the total number of rows affected across all plans.
Front-end sends: {[{ "planId": 1, "cards": [{ "cardId": 517, "data": { ... } }] }]}

For each card in the specified plan, calls Amazon Reach and Performance forecast APIs,
saves the results back to the card, and returns the updated card list.
